facts.statement: Measurements below are room-temperature toluene solution observations at 1e-5 mol/L; fluorescence lifetimes follow deoxygenation.
No raw replicate errors or triplet energy measurements are supplied. These observations do not themselves determine a microscopic emission mechanism.
facts.source: Availability boundary of extracted main PDF4 Table1

measurement_definitions.definition: State the spin, geometry, medium and common energy reference. Different energy definitions are not interchangeable.
A molecular energy allowance alone is not evidence for a bimolecular rate or device efficiency.

public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
